system.description:
Will Amp

You gain a +2 bonus to your Ninjutsu Save DC.

When you being your turn in this state, you regain 1 Focus.

If you are a Bonded creature, you instead regain 1 Jutsu Slot.

You make Concentration checks to maintain Ninjutsu at advantage.

You cannot benefit from Jutsu, features or traits that boosts the damage you deal with Ninjutsu.
system.summary: +2 Ninjutsu save DC, 1 Focus at the start of your turn (a Bonded creature: a jutsu slot), Ninjutsu concentration at advantage, no damage boosts.

rules.text: Start: when you enter Crash or Flow, spend 1 Focus; your Bonded creature enters Crash Duality (give it that card).
A Bonded creature regains 1 jutsu slot instead of Focus at the start of its turn (at the table).
You cannot benefit from jutsu, features or traits that boost the damage you deal with Ninjutsu.
